mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park tonight, and you can spot the International Space Station crossing the sky for one minute starting at 9:59 PM. It will rise in the northwest over Verona High School and travel toward the northeast near the Home Depot, staying low near the horizon. Expect an overnight low of 54 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

For our city news, the Verona Police Department is currently accepting applications for its Citizen Academy, a free nine-week program covering everything from O W I investigations to use of force. Additionally, general election notices for the November 3rd election have been posted.

It is a busy weekend in town. The Dane County Farmers' Market is happening today, with live music throughout the day at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival brings 140 miles of excitement to our streets tomorrow, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness on September 14th.
On Wednesday, September 10th, officers responded to a burglary on Hunter's Cove Way. A 19-year-old suspect was taken into custody after a firearm was discharged, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Cashew. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to head out and grab a treat.
